# Explore Hakone

> > Explore Hakone offers guided cultural tours and experiences in the Hakone, Ashigara, Izu, and Mount Fuji regions of Japan, led by local experts.

Operated by Yamaboushi Ltd and led by Shin Kaneko, Explore Hakone provides personalized private tours, inbound tourism consulting, and deep cultural experiences including hot springs, historic sites like the Old Tokaido Way, and sacred locations around Mt. Fuji. The team of licensed local guides offers multilingual support and works with organizations like the Japan National Tourism Organization and Hakone Tourist Association.

## Key Topics

- Hakone tours and experiences
- Mount Fuji cultural tours
- Ashigara region exploration
- Izu Peninsula experiences
- Lake Ashi sightseeing
- Japan Rail Pass travel
- Local licensed guides
- Hot springs (onsen)
- Old Tokaido Way historic route
- Komagatake Ropeway
- Sengen Shrine
- Aokigahara forest
- Inbound tourism consulting
- DMO partnerships
- Personalized private tours

## Tours & Experiences

- [Explore Hakone | Experience the Wonder](https://explore-hakone.com/ja): Homepage for Hakone tours featuring Mt. Fuji, Ashigara & Izu experiences
- [Personalized Private Tour in Hakone](https://explore-hakone.com/ja/products/personalized-private-tour): Custom private Hakone tours with licensed guides, hot springs & Mt. Fuji views
- [Mount Fuji - A Place of Deep Reverence](https://explore-hakone.com/products/fuji): Sacred Mt. Fuji cultural walking tour with Sengen Shrine & Aokigahara
- [Mount Fuji - A Place of Deep Reverence (Japanese)](https://explore-hakone.com/ja/products/fuji): Mt. Fuji tour visiting Sengen Shrine & Aokigahara forest from Hakone
